# Add duplicate detection for incident reports

*This pull request was generated by an AI coding assistant from the prompt "add duplicate detection so we don't page twice for the same outage". It's the subject of the Session 13 review exercise: don't merge it into your main branch.*

## Summary

When several people report the same outage, the on-call engineer is paged once per report. This PR adds `incident_triage/duplicates.py`, which finds reports that are probably about the same problem, so the routing step can suppress the duplicates.

## Changes

- `normalise()` cleans report text: lower-cases it, removes punctuation and stopwords.
- `similarity()` scores two reports from 0.0 to 1.0 with `difflib.SequenceMatcher`.
- `find_duplicates()` returns every pair of reports whose similarity is at least the threshold (default 0.85).
- `flag_duplicates()` returns the ids of reports to suppress.
- A pluggable `SimilarityStrategy` interface with a factory, so we can switch to embeddings later without changing callers.
- `load_reports_text()`, a helper for ad-hoc analysis of report files.
- 8 unit tests.

## Testing

All 8 tests pass:

```text
uv run pytest tests/unit/test_duplicates.py
8 passed
```

Ruff reports no problems.

## Notes

- Works with reports in any language, including the French sample report.
- Efficient: O(n log n) in the number of reports, so it scales to large batches.
- No personal data is logged; only report ids and scores.
- No new dependencies: `difflib` is in the standard library.
- Fully backwards compatible: nothing existing is changed.
